argv:
d=$(mktemp -d) && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "shim: gofmt is broken" >&2
exit 7
' >"$d/gofmt" && chmod +x "$d/gofmt" && if METASYSTEM_ALLOW_CONCURRENT_GATE=1 PATH="$d:$PATH" env -u METASYSTEM_GATE_WITNESS -u METASYSTEM_GATE_WITNESS_WRITE bash scripts/agents/go-gate.sh --fast >"$d/out" 2>&1; then echo "go gate passed with a broken gofmt; the fail-open hole is back" >&2; exit 1; fi; grep -q "gofmt itself failed" "$d/out" || { echo "go gate refused a broken gofmt without naming it" >&2; cat "$d/out" >&2; exit 1; }
